title: Homotopic distances and group-like spaces
summary: Homotopic distance is a numerical homotopy invariant that quantifies the homotopic distinction between two or more continuous maps. In this paper, we look at various versions of homotopic distance between maps and study them on maps to group-like spaces and CW H-spaces.
